ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_record is
begin
 if (:attrib_group is null and :attrib_code is not null) or
 (:attrib_code is null and :attrib_group is not null) then
 show_error_dist('0383');
 end if;
 loop
 execute_trigger('VALIDATE_FIELD');
 check_package_failure;
 exit when :system.cursor_field = 'VALID_DONOR_OVERRIDES_STAGE.TERM_DATE';
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end loop; 
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_DUPS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure check_dups is
 current_record varchar2(3);
 current_field varchar2(100);
 cue varchar2(1);
 product_t varchar2(5);
 inter_code varchar2(5);
 attrib_group varchar2(6);
 attrib_code varchar2(6);
begin
 if :valid_donor_overrides_stage.rowid is null
 then
 select distinct 'x'
 into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_donor_overrides_stage
 where donor_decision_code = :donor_decision_code
 and product_type = :product_type
 and inter_code = :inter_code
 and nvl(attrib_group,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:attrib_group,'XXXXXX')
 and nvl(attrib_code,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:attrib_code,'XXXXXX');
 show_error_dist('5238');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 current_field := :system.cursor_field;
 current_record := :system.cursor_record;
 cue := :donor_decision_code;
 product_t := :valid_donor_overrides_stage.product_type;
 inter_code := :valid_donor_overrides_stage.inter_code;
 attrib_group := :attrib_group;
 attrib_code := :attrib_code;
 go_record('1');
 loop
 if current_record != :system.cursor_record and
 cue = :donor_decision_code and
 product_t = :product_type and
 inter_code = :inter_code and
 nvl(attrib_group,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:attrib_group,'XXXXXX') and
 nvl(attrib_code,'XXXXXX') = nvl(:attrib_code,'XXXXXX')
 then
 go_record(current_record);
 show_error_dist('5238');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 go_record(current_record);
 GO_ITEM(current_field);
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare 
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error_dist('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error_dist('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('0215');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error_dist('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error_dist('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error_dist('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error_dist('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error_dist('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error_dist('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error_dist('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0)
 then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error_dist('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error_dist('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error_dist('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('40209','40735') then
 null;

 /*Added by HCLC for removing double message */ 
 elsif error_code = 41000 then -- This function is not available
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
